subject: spanish

moments.title: Catalan statute
moments.body: Catalonia regains autonomy and recognises Catalan as a co-official language.
moments.takeaway: Spain's regional system was a post-Franco settlement.

moments.title: New statute
moments.body: A revised statute is partly struck down by Spain's Constitutional Court in 2010, fuelling independence sentiment.

moments.title: Independence referendum
moments.body: An illegal referendum is held; Catalan leaders are tried for sedition. Police violence at polling stations draws international attention.

now.title: Catalonia today
now.body: Pardons (2021) and amnesty law (2024) shape ongoing tension. Catalan language policy remains contested.

reflection: Spain has always been many countries inside one.
